contracts.numericPacket: Five independent presence bits and IEEE values. Unmasked fields retain legacy JSON; masked values override only corresponding fields.
contracts.date: now convenience follows actual new Date(input).getTime() before number transport.
contracts.boundary: Upstream now:null coerces0; this runtime-null value is recorded outside selected declared number|Date packet scope.
contracts.allocation: Worker timeout, heap and returned-output guards are oracle harness budgets, never claimed Pele errors.

scope: Bounded well-formed source/SVG cases. No arbitrary object coercion; numbers outside Date range are tested only through Date→NaN, never as giant finite raw now. Nonfinite geometry may intentionally produce SVG coordinates unsuitable for display; exact returned strings remain the oracle.
